$comment: Frozen M0 tool catalogue (docs/RUNTIME_MCP_CONTRACT.md §4). Changing it after M0 acceptance is a contract revision.

authority_rules.direct_proof: Administrator grant, admin.mode=fresh_proof, and an assertion carrying the preview's server nonce (proof_nonce_claim) with fresh auth_time; the proof is consumed once together with the effect. Refused when admin.mode=disabled.
authority_rules.direct_proof_or_approval: Either direct_proof by the administrative identity that will own the job, or an unexpired approval_id issued by admin_confirm for exactly this preview, digest and data generation and presented by the same agent actor that created the preview; the approval is consumed with the job insert. A proof or approval is never reusable for another preview or operation.
authority_rules.grant: Effective tier (token scope ∩ grant) ≥ tool tier and the tool is in the grant's allowed list. A mutating 'grant' tool is refused for an Administrator grant in every mode.
authority_rules.idempotent_retry: A retry with the same idempotency key returns the original result only if every admitted binding field (preview_id, parameter_digest, data generation, and approval_id where used) is identical; otherwise idempotency_conflict.
authority_rules.upload_session: Only the actor whose transfer_upload_begin admitted the session, within its expiry, with Administrator effective tier; no new proof per chunk (continuation of one admitted operation); offsets must be contiguous and never exceed the declared length; finalize requires the complete length and matching SHA-256 and is idempotent; abort by that actor only and not after import. The import itself is a separate import_finalize preview (owner only, finalized uploads only, once per upload) requiring its own direct proof.
